Identify waiting time = time between “Item Picking COMPLETE” and “Packing START” where cold station utilization > 90%. Metric: *Cold-Packing Contention Delay* (average and 95th percentile waiting time attributable to occupied stations).

- **Shipping Batching**: Detect batching via identical “System (Batch XX)” resource label on “Shipping Label Gen.”. Measure *Batch Waiting Time* = difference between an order’s “Quality Check COMPLETE” and the latest “Quality Check COMPLETE” timestamp among all orders sharing the same batch ID. Aggregate by region and batch size.

Flag violations or near-misses (>8 concurrent). Metric: *Hazardous Capacity Utilization* and *Regulatory Idle Time* (time orders wait before entering Packing/QC when count ≥ 9).

**Differentiation of waiting times**: Apply causal trace enrichment. Tag each waiting segment as:
- *Within-instance* if preceding activity duration of the same case exceeds its historical 75th percentile.
- *Between-instance* if the resource is occupied by another case (cold station, QC staff) **or** a batch-mate has not yet reached the synchronization point. Use inter-case dependency graphs (Heuristics Miner on correlated attributes) and interval-based overlap analysis on timestamp intervals.
